message.content: {"note_claim": "A May 2026 explosion suspended Blue Origin's New Glenn operations until late 2026 at earliest, with no launches or landings since April 2026.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "On May 28, 2026, a New Glenn rocket operated by Blue Origin exploded during a static fire test... New Glenn launch operations suspended pending investigation and repairs", "reason": "The page confirms the May 2026 explosion, the suspension of New Glenn operations, and that the last flight before the explosion was in April 2026, with return to flight not expected before end of 2026."}

parsed.note_claim: A May 2026 explosion suspended Blue Origin's New Glenn operations until late 2026 at earliest, with no launches or landings since April 2026.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: On May 28, 2026, a New Glenn rocket operated by Blue Origin exploded during a static fire test... New Glenn launch operations suspended pending investigation and repairs
parsed.reason: The page confirms the May 2026 explosion, the suspension of New Glenn operations, and that the last flight before the explosion was in April 2026, with return to flight not expected before end of 2026.
